detailed_descriptions.en: Since the dawn of mankind, mysterious phenomena beyond human comprehension have occurred. Your studies suggest that everything is part of one big picture. The solution is near; the next expedition will be the crucial one. You turn your gaze to the stars: what lies hidden in the unfathomable depths of the cosmos? Night falls as the horn’s haunting call echoes through the woods. The Great Ceremony is about to begin, and nothing will ever be the same again. Cosmic Fear is a disturbing Lovecraftian first-person horror adventure from the author of The Land of Pain and The Alien Cube . Investigate signs of an ancient presence and uncover a forgotten chapter of humanity’s past. MAIN FEATURES: Survive deadly encounters Face unpredictable dangers and stay alive as you navigate hostile environments where every step may lead to a new threat. Investigate and solve puzzles Explore, search for clues and solve puzzles to progress deeper into the unknown. Compelling story Dive into a story filled with mystery and terror, drawn from the darkest corners of Lovecraft’s mind. Stunning visuals Experience highly detailed environments with cutting‑edge graphics powered by photogrammetry and Unreal Engine 5. Dynamic lights, shadows and volumetric fog create a visceral, oppressive atmosphere. Immersive sounds Immerse yourself in a haunting soundscape, where even the slightest noise suggests something lurking in the dark. A new chapter in the series Expand the universe of The Land of Pain and The Alien Cube in this haunting new adventure.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Since the dawn of mankind, mysterious phenomena beyond human comprehension have occurred. Your studies suggest that everything is part of one big picture. The solution is near; the next expedition will be the crucial one. You turn your gaze to the stars: what lies hidden in the unfathomable depths of the cosmos?

Night falls as the horn’s haunting call echoes through the woods. The Great Ceremony is about to begin, and nothing will ever be the same again.

Cosmic Fear is a disturbing Lovecraftian first-person horror adventure from the author of The Land of Pain and The Alien Cube. Investigate signs of an ancient presence and uncover a forgotten chapter of humanity’s past.

MAIN FEATURES:

Survive deadly encounters

Face unpredictable dangers and stay alive as you navigate hostile environments where every step may lead to a new threat.

Investigate and solve puzzles

Explore, search for clues and solve puzzles to progress deeper into the unknown.

Compelling story

Dive into a story filled with mystery and terror, drawn from the darkest corners of Lovecraft’s mind.

Stunning visuals

Experience highly detailed environments with cutting‑edge graphics powered by photogrammetry and Unreal Engine 5. Dynamic lights, shadows and volumetric fog create a visceral, oppressive atmosphere.

Immersive sounds

Immerse yourself in a haunting soundscape, where even the slightest noise suggests something lurking in the dark.

A new chapter in the series

Expand the universe of The Land of Pain and The Alien Cube in this haunting new adventure.
